    All Classes and Interfaces

    Classes
    Class
    Description
    ChatThread
    A thread task that simulates sending a chat message between two UniversityStudent objects.
    DataParser
    DataParser allows for reading and parsing student data files into UniversityStudent objects.
    FriendRequestThread
    A thread task that simulates sending a friend request between two UniversityStudent objects.
    GaleShapley
    Implements the Gale–Shapley stable matching algorithm to assign roommate pairs based on student preference lists.
    Main
    Main.java - Self-contained testing and grading with multiple built‑in test cases.
    PodFormation
    Handles grouping students into pods based on their relationships within a StudentGraph.
    ReferralPathFinder
    Allows for finding referral paths in a student graph using Dijkstra's algorithm.
    Student
    Represents a student profile with standard identification information as well as roommate preferences and a list of previous internships.
    StudentGraph
    Represents an undirected weighted graph where each node is a UniversityStudent and edges represent connection strengths between students.
    StudentGraph.Edge
    Represents a weighted edge connecting a student to another student.
    UniversityStudent
    Represents a university student and provides an implementation for calculating connection strength based on shared attributes such as roommate status, internships, major, and age.
